why.title: Plenty of companies sell robots. Here is how we differ.
why.intro: If you are comparing suppliers, these six things usually decide it.

build.title: We build it ourselves
build.body: Circuit boards, firmware, kiosk frames, and the apps on them are made by our team. When something needs changing for your venue, we change it at the source instead of waiting on a factory.

team.title: The team is close by
team.body: Installation, staff and teacher training, servicing, and spare parts are handled by the same team in Bali. No waiting for a technician from overseas.

try.title: Try it before you decide
try.body: The receptionist demo and the education simulator run in your browser with no sign-up. Schools can start with a pilot programme.

local.title: Local language, local rules
local.body: The robots speak Indonesian and English. Signage uses Aksara Bali as Bali’s Pergub 80/2018 requires, and the curriculum is mapped to the Coding and Artificial Intelligence subject.
local.link: Aksara Bali on the kiosk screen

offline.title: Keeps working when the internet drops
offline.body: Speech is processed on a local server, and the assistant still answers from the venue’s own data when the connection is lost. Guests are not left waiting.

honest.title: Specs as they are
honest.body: Anything still being tested is called a design. We state the TKDN percentage only once the certificate is issued. Better a small promise kept.
honest.link: What we left out of SD v1

services.title: Beyond the two lines
services.intro: The same team also takes on custom projects, as long as they are close to what we do every day.
services.otherBody: Tell us about it. If it is outside our field, we will point you to someone who can help.
